notes.title: Opening Theme “Transfinity” MV Now Live!
notes.content:
We’ve already announced it on X, but you can now watch the MV for “Transfinity,” the opening theme of Glass Beads, ahead of the game’s release!
While many details are still under wraps, the track—brought to life by vocalist Yua Mizuno and our talented team—has turned out spectacularly. Please give it a listen and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Steam Store Page Now Live!
notes.content:
Our Steam store page is officially open!

Aboard a malfunctioning interstellar ship, two perfectly ordinary passengers are abruptly awakened from cold sleep. Together, they must help the ship’s damaged AI “remember” mathematics by reconstructing it through a series of eccentric puzzles.

With a heart‑warming story, cozy hand‑drawn illustrations, and an emotional soundtrack, “Glass Beads” lets you experience math‑driven concepts filled with a true sense of wonder. Development is in full swing!

Future updates will be posted here on the Steam Community Hub and on our official website. Please add the game to your wishlist and stay tuned!
